description: Pipeline Orchestrator and CLI Integration - Wire all modules together into the complete pipeline orchestrator with proper ordering (sync BEFORE shots), project.json serialization/deserialization, confidence gating, CLI subcommand handlers, and end-to-end flow. This covers spec sections 18-20, 26, 28-29.
steps: Create src/auto_openmatte/pipeline/orchestrator.py implementing: (a) class Pipeline with run_analyze(hdr_path, om_path, options) - executes the FULL analysis pipeline in EXACT order from spec: 1.inspect files, 2.identify streams, 3.synchronize, 4.verify sync, 5.detect HDR shots, 6.map shots to OM, 7.align geometry, 8.analyze common area, 9.estimate luminance mapping, 10.estimate color mapping, 11.generate per-shot transforms, 12.validate transforms. Stops with error if any step fails confidence threshold. (b) run_preview(project_path) - loads project.json, generates preview video and contact sheet. (c) run_render(project_path, output_path) - loads project.json, executes full render. (d) Each step logs progress and can be individually re-run.

Create src/auto_openmatte/pipeline/project.py implementing: (a) class ProjectFile with save(path) and load(path) classmethods. Contains: source_metadata for both files, sync_model, shot_list with mappings, geometry_per_shot, transforms_per_shot, validation_results, status. (b) validate_project(project) - checks all required fields are present and valid. (c) create_output_directories(base_path) - creates analysis/, analysis/source/, analysis/sync/, analysis/shots/, analysis/geometry/, analysis/color/, analysis/reports/, transforms/, previews/, output/ per spec section 20.

Update src/auto_openmatte/cli.py to wire subcommands to Pipeline methods: (a) analyze subcommand calls Pipeline.run_analyze, prints formatted report per spec section 28 (source info, sync results, shot detection, geometry, color analysis, project status). (b) preview subcommand calls Pipeline.run_preview. (c) render subcommand calls Pipeline.run_render. (d) All CLI output is formatted clearly with section headers.

Create src/auto_openmatte/pipeline/confidence.py implementing: (a) check_sync_confidence(sync_result, threshold) - gates pipeline if sync confidence too low. (b) check_alignment_confidence(geometry_results, threshold) - gates pipeline if alignment is poor. (c) check_color_confidence(color_results, threshold) - identifies and reports low-confidence shots without stopping. (d) generate_quality_warnings(project) - collects all potential issues for the final report.

Create tests/test_pipeline.py with tests: (a) test_pipeline_step_ordering (verify sync runs before shot detection), (b) test_pipeline_stops_on_low_sync_confidence, (c) test_pipeline_continues_with_low_color_confidence_warning, (d) test_project_json_serialization_roundtrip, (e) test_project_json_contains_all_required_fields, (f) test_output_directory_creation, (g) test_cli_analyze_argument_parsing, (h) test_cli_preview_requires_project, (i) test_cli_render_requires_project_and_output, (j) test_formatted_report_output_matches_spec

Create tests/test_project_file.py with tests: (a) test_save_and_load_roundtrip, (b) test_project_validation_missing_sync, (c) test_project_validation_missing_shots, (d) test_project_contains_source_metadata, (e) test_project_contains_transforms
acceptance_criteria: Pipeline enforces strict ordering: inspect -> sync -> verify sync -> shots -> map shots -> geometry -> luminance -> color -> transforms -> validate
Pipeline stops with clear error message if sync confidence is below threshold
Pipeline stops with clear error message if detected HDR format is unsupported
project.json serialization/deserialization roundtrip preserves all data
project.json contains all fields from spec section 19
CLI 'analyze' prints formatted report matching spec section 28 format
CLI 'preview' and 'render' load existing project.json without re-analyzing
Output directory structure matches spec section 20
All tests pass with 'pytest tests/test_pipeline.py tests/test_project_file.py -v'
